setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: The norns matrix and toolkit mods are installed and enabled, and the norns tempo is 90 BPM. Channel 1 plays the four-step phrase (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) through a CC device with Rate /1, the sequencer is stopped, and the Matrix has no routes yet. The Device page for CH01 is showing.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open MODS > MATRIX. Choose MOSAIC CH 1: CC DEVICE and select Fixed Note, the parameter the LFO will drive. Press K3 to open Fixed Note's sources and turn E2 to lfo 1; its row shows dashes, no depth yet. Hold E3 turning right until lfo 1's depth reads 1.00, so the LFO controls Fixed Note at full strength.
steps.title: Route lfo 1 to Fixed Note at full depth

steps.caption: Open the parameters list, choose toolkit lfo 1 (PARAMETERS / lfo 1) and select clocked, which makes the LFO follow the tempo instead of running in seconds. Press K3 to switch it on: clocked shows a filled marker.
steps.title: Clock the LFO to the tempo

steps.caption: Turn E2 down one row to Beats, the LFO period in beats. It reads 1/4. Turn E3 right until Beats reads 4, a period of four beats. Turn E2 down two rows to Shape, which still reads sine.
steps.title: Set the period and the shape

steps.caption: Turn E3 two detents to choose Pulse. Shape now reads pulse.
steps.title: Choose Pulse

steps.caption: Tap K1 and press Play. The LFO now alternates every two beats, half of its four-beat period: eight steps at MIDI 127, the Fixed Note pitch, then eight steps of the authored phrase, 60, 62, 64, 65, repeating. The MIDI strip lists the notes in that order.
steps.title: Play the phrase
